newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish Concordia buys vessels in U.S..
newsitem.headline: Swedish Concordia buys vessels in U.S..

text.p: Concordia Maritime AB, a Swedish shipping company 50 percent owned by Stena Line AB, said it had bought one VLCC and four bulk carriers from Universe Tankships in New York.
Concordia, which is also 12.5 percent owned by Svenska Handelsbanken said the transaction would be positive for its results but gave no details.
It said it would make a 30 million crown gain on selling the 273,000-tonne VLCC Stena Conductor on to Stena Bulk AB, which charters the vessel and had a purchase option on it.

Gothenburg-based Concordia said Universe Tankships was founded by businessman Daniel K.Ludwig who on his death bequeathed it to an American cancer research foundation. The foundation was now selling the entire company and its assets.
Concordia and Stena Bulk have a 10-year working relationship with Universe, which is also known as the Ludwig Group.
It named the four bulk carriers as Pinoak, Locust, Conveyor and Kure. -- Tony Austin, Stockholm newsroom +46-8-700-1004
